text: Beginning May 3, Upwork retired the tiered freelancer service-fee structure and moved to a flat 10% fee for all relationships, with transition treatment for existing 5% contracts.
Upwork introduced a contract initiation fee for Marketplace clients in April 2023, assessed on new fixed-price and hourly contracts.
Q2 2023 total take rate was 16.3%, versus 15.0% a year earlier; management said the increase was largely due to the simplified freelancer pricing structure and other Connects monetization strategies.
Upwork reported freelancers with an Availability Badge received 55% more invites and that invites sent to badged freelancers were accepted 77% more often.
Upwork reported that a successfully boosted proposal increased a freelancer's chance of getting hired by approximately 20%.
Ads & Monetization revenue grew 93% year over year; Freelancer Plus exceeded 100,000 active subscriptions and revenue grew 76% year over year.
Upwork added more Connects and Chat Pro to Freelancer Plus and increased its price point; management said the changes contributed to its highest take rate and Ads & Monetization growth.
Ads & Monetization revenue grew 75% year over year and Connects revenue grew 81% year over year in Q2 2024.
Ads & Monetization revenue grew 35% year over year and Freelancer Plus subscription revenue grew 48% year over year in Q3 2024.
Ads & Monetization revenue increased 51% year over year in 2024 and Freelancer Plus subscription revenue grew 58% year over year.
